items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: Nellie Lutcher, bless her heart, she came and she said, 'Helen I'll stay right here with you until you go on'. She said, 'don't be scared'. And I said, 'well you know every time I get nervous and I get hoarse and everything'. She ran across the street to the drug store and she brought me more cough

ctx.x: On the piano I like Mary Lou and Connie Berry and Nellie Lutcher and Rose Murphy.
Oh, yeah. Is she working around here still?
